L3.name: LTC MWEB exploit + 13-block reorg — Day 2
L3.desc: First-ever coordinated 13-block reorg on a major PoW chain. Attacker exploited an MWEB privacy-layer bug to mint invalid pegged-out LTC, paired with a DoS targeting patched mining pools so unpatched nodes formed the canonical chain. Pre-funded wallet via Binance 38h before the event with destination address pre-configured to swap LTC→ETH on a DEX (premeditation). Coordination crisis: consensus patch was privately distributed Mar 19–26 but never broadcast or required to mining pools — ~4-week delay.
L3.act: 立即由风控/上币团队评估：(a) OKX LTC 充提是否已暂停或加白名单，至少要求 v0.21.4 patched 节点；(b) MWEB 类资产风险敞口复核（其他隐私扩展层资产）；(c) 与币安沟通该攻击者地址是否已封禁
